desc: One color: single result card and an add button asking confirmation
"شوف كل الأطقم (N)" shown when there are more than the 3 examples
First 12 outfits listed (or all if fewer), each with names and score
"عرض كمان" loads the next chunk until all N are shown
Every one of the N new outfits is reachable

Opening one color leaves the others closed (independent)
No horizontal overflow with the full list open
